verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 3.77
8. Ānandavagga
Dutiyabhavasutta
Atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then Venerable Ānanda went up to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and said to him:

verses.pali: “bhavo, bhavoti, bhante, vuccati.
verses.english: “Sir, they speak of this thing called ‘continued existence’.

verses.pali: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, bhavo hotī”ti?
“Kāmadhātuvepakkañca, ānanda, kammaṁ nābhavissa, api nu kho kāmabhavo paññāyethā”ti?
verses.english: “If, Ānanda, there were no deeds to result in the sensual realm, would continued existence in the sensual realm still come about?”

verses.pali: “No hetaṁ, bhante”.
“Iti kho, ānanda, kammaṁ khettaṁ, viññāṇaṁ bījaṁ, taṇhā sneho.
verses.english: “So, Ānanda, deeds are the field, consciousness is the seed, and craving is the moisture.

verses.pali: Avijjānīvaraṇānaṁ sattānaṁ taṇhāsaṁyojanānaṁ hīnāya dhātuyā cetanā patiṭṭhitā patthanā patiṭṭhitā evaṁ āyatiṁ punabbhavābhinibbatti hoti.
verses.english: The intention and aim of sentient beings—shrouded by ignorance and fettered by craving—is established in a lower realm. That’s how there is regeneration into a new state of existence in the future.

verses.pali: Rūpadhātuvepakkañca, ānanda, kammaṁ nābhavissa, api nu kho rūpabhavo paññāyethā”ti?
verses.english: If there were no deeds to result in the realm of luminous form, would continued existence in the realm of luminous form still come about?”

verses.pali: “No hetaṁ, bhante”.
“Iti kho, ānanda, kammaṁ khettaṁ, viññāṇaṁ bījaṁ, taṇhā sneho.
verses.english: “So, Ānanda, deeds are the field, consciousness is the seed, and craving is the moisture.

verses.pali: Avijjānīvaraṇānaṁ sattānaṁ taṇhāsaṁyojanānaṁ majjhimāya dhātuyā cetanā patiṭṭhitā patthanā patiṭṭhitā evaṁ āyatiṁ punabbhavābhinibbatti hoti.
verses.english: The intention and aim of sentient beings—shrouded by ignorance and fettered by craving—is established in a middle realm. That’s how there is regeneration into a new state of existence in the future.

verses.pali: Arūpadhātuvepakkañca, ānanda, kammaṁ nābhavissa, api nu kho arūpabhavo paññāyethā”ti?
verses.english: If there were no deeds to result in the formless realm, would continued existence in the formless realm still come about?”

verses.pali: “No hetaṁ, bhante”.
“Iti kho, ānanda, kammaṁ khettaṁ, viññāṇaṁ bījaṁ, taṇhā sneho.
verses.english: “So, deeds are the field, consciousness is the seed, and craving is the moisture.

verses.pali: Avijjānīvaraṇānaṁ sattānaṁ taṇhāsaṁyojanānaṁ paṇītāya dhātuyā cetanā patiṭṭhitā patthanā patiṭṭhitā evaṁ āyatiṁ punabbhavābhinibbatti hoti.
verses.english: The intention and aim of sentient beings—shrouded by ignorance and fettered by craving—is established in a higher realm. That’s how there is regeneration into a new state of existence in the future.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, ānanda, bhavo hotī”ti.
verses.english: That’s how continued existence is defined.”

verses.pali: Sattamaṁ.
